somatic gene therapy is a promising treatment for diabetes, but the immunological safety system is an essential requirement.
the immunological safety system is a useful tool for somatic gene therapies with transplanted cells.

we have developed an animal model with a safety system for complete removal of transplanted cells and that we have proven the feasibility of the use of fibroblasts as the cell source for somatic gene transfer.
